name: Pantheon
tagline: Roman temple, later church, in Rome.

instance_of: Museum of the Italian Ministry of Culture

construction.quote: The Pantheon (UK: , US: ; Latin: Pantheum, from Ancient Greek  Πάνθειον (Pantheion) '[temple] of all the gods') is an ancient Polytheist temple in Rome, Italy, originally built under Roman emperor Augustus (27 BC–AD 14) and reconstructed under Hadrian (117–138).

scenes.title: Ancient
scenes.caption: As a result of excavations in the late 19th century, archaeologist Rodolfo Lanciani concluded that Agrippa's Pantheon was oriented so that it faced south, in contrast with the current layout that faces north, and that it had a shortened T-shaped plan with the entrance at the base of the "T".
